name: sunday-ball

scripts.seed:local: node scripts/seed.mjs --reset && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .seed/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm test && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.seed:demo: node scripts/seed.mjs roster.sample.csv --reset --demo && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .seed/seed.sql

description: Weekly sign-up app for a pickup basketball group: full-timer priority, drop-in waitlist, text reminders. Cloudflare Workers + D1.
